transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you so much for seeing me today. Um, well, I guess I've just been having a little bit of trouble at work lately. I'm a hairstylist, and... I don't know, it's probably just me being off my game, but it feels like my hands are moving through glue. 

Like, even just doing the basic stuff, you know? Sectioning hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever right now. I try really hard to keep my pace up, I promise I do, but people have started noticing that I'm just... slower than I used to be. It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly. I hope it's okay that I brought that up first... is that the kind of thing you need to know?
Besides the slowness, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Um... yeah, a little bit, I guess. I mean, everyone gets a little down sometimes, right? I try really hard to stay positive, I promise. 

But... well, most days lately, I wake up with this... I don't know, it's like this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. And it just makes me feel like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning. Which I know sounds so ungrateful, and I'm really sorry if it seems like I'm just complaining. I know I should be more upbeat and just push through it. 

Is that... does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you noticed any shaking or tremor in your hands, especially when they're resting and not being used?

Um, no, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My hands don't shake or anything when I'm just sitting there. I mean, maybe a tiny bit if I've had too much coffee, but that's normal, right? Everyone gets a little jittery sometimes. But no, no real shaking or tremors or anything like that. I hope that's a good thing? I really want to be helpful and give you the right answers.
Have you ever had a period, even for a few days, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, honestly, I kind of wish I had a burst of energy like that right now, it would probably really help me keep up at the salon. But... no, I usually need all my sleep just to get by. 

I've never really felt, um, elated or anything like that. Just kind of my normal self, or, well, a little heavy lately like I mentioned. I hope that's okay? Like, I'm sorry if that's not the answer you were looking for... I just want to make sure I'm doing this right and being helpful.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold, gaining weight, or feeling excessively tired lately, even when you're getting enough rest?

Um, no... I don't think I've had any of that. I mean, I'm always a little tired because standing all day at the salon takes it out of you, but I think that's just normal tired, you know? Not excessive or anything. 

And my weight has been pretty steady, I try to be really careful about that so I look professional for work. I definitely haven't felt unusually cold either. Just... normal, I guess. 

Is it bad if I don't have any of those things? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right pieces so you can figure out what's wrong with me. I really am trying my best to be a good patient.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, in the past, where you felt this same kind of heavy sadness and slowness for weeks or longer?

Um... no, I don't think I have. I mean, I've had normal bad days before, you know? Like if I mess up a client's color or something, I might get a little down for a day or two. But never anything like this... where it just drags on and I feel so slow and heavy for weeks. This is really the first time it's been quite this bad. 

Is... is that okay? I mean, I hope I'm not wasting your time if it hasn't happened before. I just really want to get back to being my normal, upbeat self for the salon, so I want to make sure I'm answering everything exactly how you need me to. Did I explain that right?
